fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 12350 Philadelphia Ave, Mira Loma/Eastvale CA - historically DSC Logistics Bldg 3, now CJ Logistics America. Large N-S oriented warehouse running along the I-15 freeway.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate or guard booth visible at any access point in Street View probes from 2025. Truck court connects to the road network at the SW corner via an open paved driveway crossing a rail spur. Typical open multi-tenant industrial-park access. Perimeter is partially fenced (chain-link visible on the south side).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large drop yard on the east side between building and freeway, filled with 50+ trailers in marked diagonal stalls; second smaller drop area at the SW corner.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur curves into the property at the SW corner; mainline rail also runs along the south boundary.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~70 dock doors across the east face and south face from overhead imagery; low-confidence count - imagery shows a regular bay rhythm but exact total is approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Inland Empire (Mira Loma/Eastvale) warehouse district - clearly Urban.
